title: Git Worktree Manager workspace configuration
description: Configures the child repositories managed alongside a Git Worktree Manager workspace.

repo.description: Child repositories keyed by safe relative paths under the main repository.

propertyNames.description: A relative repository path. Absolute paths and '.' or '..' path segments are not allowed.

name.description: Display name shown in the repository picker.

remote.description: Git remote URL or clone source used when the repository is missing.
